community.name: Talon Preserve
community.roll: Sarasota County 2026 certified roll, obtained 11 September 2026
community.cdd_note: There is no community development district here. On one verified 2026 TRIM notice from Talon Preserve the whole non-ad valorem side was $660 a year, and all of it was county fire rescue, solid waste and stormwater. No CDD bond, no district assessment. For comparison, one Gran Paradiso notice showed $2,721 and one Sarasota National notice showed $2,246. That is one parcel each, not an average, but the difference is the district and not the rounding.
